notes: Baseline for the v522_arima_lite stream (cfm_agent_v_5_2 built through build_cfm_agent_config_arima_only -- ARIMA alone in the ensemble, no Kalman and no LightGBM -- with every LLM call on gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview). Deliberately empty: an empty settings_overlay plus an identity layer means the agent runs exactly as shipped, so v001 is a true no-op and every later version is a measurable delta from it. This stream shares an agent package, a model and a cadence with v52_lite and differs only in the ensemble, which is the comparison it exists to support -- so it keeps a separate ledger and a separate corpus, and the distinct fingerprint prefix on V52_ARIMA_ONLY stops ComparisonPolicy.single_package_fingerprint from mistaking a corpus spanning both for a single build. Two levers are inert here by construction: settings_overlay.ensemble_weights has nothing to reweight when one model produces the forecast, and model_disagreement_std is identically zero. effective_from predates all available data on purpose: these are the constants v5.2 ships with, so v001 was in force for any cutoff a replay might ask about.
